extracted.intended_audience: IP law firm leaders, patent practitioners, legal economists, AIPLA members and researchers
extracted.subtask_description: Tabulated results from the AIPLA 2023 Economic Survey reporting firm-level metrics for IP law practices (billings, rates, salaries, insurance, training, and related policies), stratified by firm size, location, and percent-IP practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allocation of firm's IP billings, by type of work (Q24)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of the firm's 2022 IP billings allocated to: patent applications and prosecution; trademark registration and prosecution; copyright registration applications; licensing; litigation (not including post-grant actions at the USPTO); PTAB/TTAB proceedings; Privacy/Cybersecurity; Other IP work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data reported broken out by firm size (number of attorneys: e.g., 11–30, 31–100, 101 or more) and 'All Firms'. Tables provide Number of Firms Reporting, Mean (Average), First Quartile (25%), Median (Midpoint), and Third Quartile (75%).

rubrics_metrics.name: Firm's total 2022 billings for professional legal services (Q25)
rubrics_metrics.description: Firm's total 2022 billings for professional legal services (dollar amounts) reported by number of attorneys, percent of practice that is IP, and geographic location (CMSA/regions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statistics include Number of Firms Reporting, Mean (Average), First Quartile (25%), Median (Midpoint), and Third Quartile (75%). Data are presented for multiple segments (attorney-count buckets, percent-IP buckets, and locations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total 2022 billings per attorney (Q25)
rubrics_metrics.description: Firm's 2022 billings per attorney (dollar amounts) reported across firm-size, percent-IP, and location segments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes First Quartile, Median, Mean (Average), and Third Quartile by segment; Number of Firms Reporting shown for each segment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Firm collections ratio, overhead percent, percent change in billings and revenue (Q26–Q29)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ratio of collections to billings in 2022; firm's overhead as a percent of total 2022 collections; percent change in firm's IP billings from 2021 to 2022; percent change in firm's IP revenue from 2021 to 2022.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values reported by number-of-attorneys buckets with Number of Firms Reporting and Mean (Average). Other summary statistics (quartiles) provided where shown in the table.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum and maximum 2022 attorney billing rates for non‑IP work (Q30a–Q30b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Minimum and maximum billing rates (per hour) charged in 2022 for non‑IP legal work, reported by number of attorneys and location.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables include Number of Firms Reporting and summary statistics (Mean/Average, First Quartile, Median, Third Quartile) for each segment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average billing rate for non‑IP work (Q30c)
rubrics_metrics.description: Average (mean) billing rate for non‑IP work in 2022, reported by firm-size and location segments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statistics include Mean (Average), Median (Midpoint), and Quartiles for each segment; Number of Firms Reporting provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum and maximum 2022 attorney billing rates for IP work (Q31a–Q31b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Minimum and maximum billing rates (per hour) charged in 2022 for IP work, by firm-size and location (e.g., Boston, NYC, San Francisco CMSAs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables show Number of Firms Reporting and First Quartile, Median, Third Quartile, and Mean for each segment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average billing rate for IP work (Q31c)
rubrics_metrics.description: Average (mean) billing rate for IP work in 2022, presented by firm-size and location segments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes First Quartile, Median, Mean (Average), Third Quartile and Number of Firms Reporting for each segment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current starting salary for a first year associate (Q32)
rubrics_metrics.description: Firm's current starting salary for a first-year associate (dollar amounts), reported by number of attorneys, percent of practice that is IP, and location.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported with First Quartile (25%), Median (Midpoint), Mean (Average), Third Quartile (75%), and Number of Firms Reporting for segments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average salary for a patent agent (Q33)
rubrics_metrics.description: Firm's average salary for a patent agent (dollar amounts), shown by firm-size, percent-IP, and location segments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables include First Quartile, Mean (Average), Median, Third Quartile and Number of Firms Reporting for each segment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average salary for an IP paralegal (Q34)
rubrics_metrics.description: Firm's average salary for an IP paralegal (dollar amounts), reported by firm-size, percent-IP, and location.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes First Quartile, Mean (Average), Median, Third Quartile and Number of Firms Reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tuition reimbursement or loan forgiveness for patent agents/technical assistants attending law school (Q35)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the firm provides tuition reimbursement or tuition loan forgiveness for patent agents or technical assistants attending law school (Yes/No percentages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percentages are reported overall and by segments (firm size, locations, percent-IP), with Number of Firms Reporting shown; tables present Yes and No percentages and totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Liability insurance coverage and deductible by size of firm in 2022 (Q36 & Q39)
rubrics_metrics.description: Firm's maximum liability insurance coverage each claim and total in 2022 (dollar amounts), and liability insurance deductible each claim and total in 2022 (dollar amounts), reported by number-of-attorneys buckets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables include Number of Firms Reporting, Mean (Average), First Quartile, Median, and Third Quartile for coverage and deductible metrics by firm-size segments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Does Q36 include cyber liability insurance? (Q37)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent indication whether the liability information provided in Q36 includes cyber liability insurance (Yes/No percentages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percentages presented overall and by firm-size/location segments with Number of Firms Reporting for each segment.

rubrics_metrics.name: If no, does the firm have cyber liability insurance? (Q38)
rubrics_metrics.description: For firms that did not include cyber liability insurance in Q36, whether the firm has cyber liability insurance (Yes/No percentages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented by segments (firm-size, locations, percent-IP) with Number of Firms Reporting; percentages shown for Yes and No responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Liability insurance cost per attorney in 2022 (Q40)
rubrics_metrics.description: Firm's liability insurance cost per attorney in 2022 (dollar amounts), reported by firm-size, number of locations, percent-IP, and location segments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables show First Quartile, Median, Mean (Average), Third Quartile, and Number of Firms Reporting for each segment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of liability claims for IP matters in the last five years (Q41)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of liability claims for IP matters made against the firm in the last five years (counts) and liability claims per attorney over the last five years (claims per attorney).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported with Number of Firms Reporting, First Quartile, Median, Mean (Average), and Third Quartile where available; some segmentation by firm-size buckets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional liability insurance underwriters used by firms (Q42)
rubrics_metrics.description: List and percent usage of professional liability insurance underwriters (e.g., ALPS, CNA, Lloyd's of London, Columbia Casualty, Jamieson, Minnesota Mutual, Oregon Professional Liability Fund, other) by firm-size segments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables provide percent of firms using each underwriter broken out by firm-size categories and 'All Firms'; Number of Firms Reporting indicated for the question.

rubrics_metrics.name: Liability insurance cost per attorney by insurance underwriter (Q42 continuation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Mean liability insurance cost per attorney in 2022 broken out by insurer (e.g., ALAS, ALPS, CNA Insurance Companies, Columbia Casualty, Jamieson, Lloyd's of London, Other insurer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provided as Mean (Average) cost per attorney with Number of Firms Reporting per insurer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spending on outside providers of attorney training as percent of gross revenue in 2022 (Q43)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage of gross revenue the firm spent on outside providers of attorney training and external attorney training programs in 2022.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statistics include Number of Firms Reporting, Mean (Average), Median (Midpoint), First Quartile (25%) and Third Quartile (75%), and are presented by firm-size and other segments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal training topics provided to attorneys (Q44)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the firm provides formal training (other than one-on-one mentorship/review) to attorneys on topics such as Business development; Personal growth or development; Leadership; Practice skills (e.g., claim drafting, case law review); Team dynamics or team building.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Yes percentages shown overall and by firm-size/segment with Number of Firms Reporting; table notes 'Percentages based on total of all respondents.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Billable hour credit for Marketing time (Q45A)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the firm gives associates billable hour credit toward their billing requirement for time spent on Marketing (Yes/No percentages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percentages presented overall and by multiple segments (firm-size, locations, percent-IP); Number of Firms Reporting provided per segment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Billable hour credit for Pro bono work (Q45B)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the firm gives associates billable hour credit toward their billing requirement for time spent on Pro bono work (Yes/No percentages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Results shown overall and by segments (firm-size, locations, percent-IP) with Number of Firms Reporting for each segment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Billable hour credit for Bar association participation (Q45C)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether associates receive billable hour credit for time spent participating in Bar association activities (Yes/No percentages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables show Yes/No percentages across segments and Number of Firms Reporting per segment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Billable hour credit for Professional organization participation (Q45D)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether associates receive billable hour credit for participation in professional organizations (Yes/No percentages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percentages provided overall and by segments with Number of Firms Reporting shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Billable hour credit for RFP process (Q45E)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether associates receive billable hour credit for time spent on the RFP (request for proposal) process (Yes/No percentages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Results displayed by firm-size, locations, percent-IP etc., with Number of Firms Reporting indicated for each segment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Billable hour credit for Newsletter drafting (Q45F)
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether associates receive billable hour credit for time spent drafting newsletters (Yes/No percentages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percentages shown overall and by segments (firm-size, location, percent-IP) with Number of Firms Reporting for each segment.
